notes: Curated, paraphrased guidance for counters commonly exported by RenderDoc through NVIDIA Nsight Perf SDK. Availability and exact semantics can vary by GPU architecture and SDK version.

entries.label: GPU duration
entries.plain: Elapsed GPU timestamp duration for the event.
entries.doesNotProve: Duration alone does not identify the limiting resource.
checks: Compare workload counts and normalized cost before interpreting hardware stalls.

entries.label: Input vertices
entries.plain: Number of vertices consumed by the input assembler.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not reveal vertex stride, attribute count, or cache behavior.
checks: Normalize vertex-stage work and memory traffic per input vertex.

entries.label: Rasterized primitives
entries.plain: Primitives that reached rasterization after earlier pipeline stages.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not directly measure covered pixels or overdraw.
checks: Compare Samples Passed and PS Invocations to separate geometry growth from pixel coverage.

entries.label: Samples passed
entries.plain: Samples that passed the configured depth and stencil tests.
entries.doesNotProve: It is not always equal to pixel shader work, especially with early/late tests, MSAA, or helper lanes.
checks: Compare PS Invocations and resolution/MSAA settings.

entries.label: Vertex shader invocations
entries.plain: Number of vertex shader executions reported by pipeline statistics.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not describe the instruction or memory cost of each invocation.
checks: Compare instructions and bytes per invocation.

entries.label: Pixel shader invocations
entries.plain: Number of pixel shader executions reported by pipeline statistics.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not by itself distinguish screen coverage, overdraw, MSAA, or helper-lane effects.
checks: Compare Samples Passed, rasterized primitives, and instructions per invocation.

entries.label: Compute shader invocations
entries.plain: Number of compute shader thread invocations.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not describe workgroup shape, divergence, or cost per thread.
checks: Normalize instructions and bytes by invocation count.

entries.label: DRAM read traffic
entries.plain: Bytes read from device memory during the measured range.
entries.doesNotProve: High traffic is not automatically a bandwidth bottleneck; duration, peak bandwidth, cache behavior, and concurrency matter.
checks: Compare bytes per invocation and effective bytes per second.

entries.label: DRAM write traffic
entries.plain: Bytes written to device memory during the measured range.
entries.doesNotProve: High writes alone do not identify the producer or show that DRAM bandwidth is saturated.
checks: Compare output/sample counts and write bytes per item.

entries.label: GPU active time
entries.plain: Time during which the measured GPU unit or range was active.
entries.doesNotProve: Active time is not interchangeable with end-to-end event duration on every architecture.
checks: Use GPU Duration as the primary elapsed-time reference when available.

entries.label: PerfWorks duration
entries.plain: PerfWorks duration measurement for the sampled range.
entries.doesNotProve: Its unit and relation to RenderDoc GPU Duration should be verified from the exported counter description.
checks: Do not silently mix it with millisecond timestamp duration.

entries.label: SM instructions executed
entries.plain: Hardware instructions executed by streaming multiprocessors.
entries.doesNotProve: It is not a source-code instruction count and can mix shader stages.
checks: Compare relative change and stage-specific instruction metrics when available.

entries.label: Stage instructions executed
entries.plain: Hardware instructions attributed to a specific shader stage.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify which source operation or shader variant added the instructions.
checks: Normalize by the matching stage invocation count and inspect the shader variant.

entries.label: L1/TEX sector hit rate
entries.plain: Share of L1TEX sector lookups served as hits.
entries.doesNotProve: A low hit rate is not necessarily costly when traffic is small or latency is hidden.
checks: Interpret together with traffic volume and long-scoreboard or throttle stalls.

entries.label: Average L1/TEX lookup hit ratio
entries.plain: Average share of L1TEX sector lookups that hit.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not show the absolute number of requests.
checks: Pair with traffic volume and elapsed time.

entries.label: L2 sector hit rate
entries.plain: Share of L2 sector lookups served as hits.
entries.doesNotProve: Hit rate alone does not measure latency or bandwidth saturation.
checks: Compare DRAM traffic and bytes per unit of work.

entries.label: Average real-time L2 hit rate
entries.plain: Average L2 sector hit rate for the measured range.
entries.doesNotProve: It is an average and can hide short expensive regions.
checks: Inspect the smallest relevant marker or draw range.

entries.label: Barrier wait
entries.plain: Warps wait for sibling warps to reach a synchronization barrier.
entries.doesNotProve: A barrier exists by design; the counter does not show which code path arrived late.
checks: Look for divergent work before the barrier and compare workgroup size.

entries.label: Branch resolution wait
entries.plain: Warps wait for branch targets and program-counter updates.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not directly quantify lane divergence.
checks: Inspect branch density and compare a controlled constant-branch variant.

entries.label: Dispatch interlock
entries.plain: A ready instruction is held back by dispatcher conflicts or interlocks.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify a user-controlled source operation.
checks: Check whether it is a persistent top contributor across matched captures.

entries.label: Warp drain wait
entries.plain: Exited warps wait for outstanding memory writes or exports to finish before resources are released.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not show which store or export dominates.
checks: Inspect write traffic near the end of the shader.

entries.label: Local/global memory queue pressure
entries.plain: The instruction queue for local and global memory operations is full.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not distinguish useful global traffic from local-memory spills.
checks: Check bytes per invocation, register pressure, and possible local-memory spills.

entries.label: Long-latency data dependency
entries.plain: Warps wait for data from an L1TEX-backed local, global, surface, or texture operation.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify the resource or prove bandwidth saturation.
checks: Compare cache hit rates, traffic per invocation, and the shader resource accesses.

entries.label: Math pipeline pressure
entries.plain: Ready warps wait because a particular math execution pipeline is oversubscribed.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify the source expression or guarantee that ALU is the frame-level bottleneck.
checks: Compare instruction mix and a simplified shader variant.

entries.label: Memory barrier wait
entries.plain: Warps wait for a memory barrier and outstanding memory operations.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not show whether the barrier is unnecessary.
checks: Inspect memory ordering and the work preceding the barrier.

entries.label: MIO pipeline queue pressure
entries.plain: The queue for shared-memory, special-math, and related MIO instructions is full.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not distinguish shared-memory traffic, dynamic branches, and special-function instructions.
checks: Use shared-memory counters and instruction mix to separate the causes.

entries.label: Miscellaneous hardware wait
entries.plain: A warp is stalled for a hardware reason not represented by the other categories.
entries.doesNotProve: This category is not actionable by itself.
checks: Look for stronger counters before forming a conclusion.

entries.label: Instruction availability wait
entries.plain: A warp waits for instruction fetch or selection to fetch an instruction.
entries.doesNotProve: It can be normal for short workloads and does not automatically mean instruction-cache pressure.
checks: Compare workload length, branch structure, and shader code size.

entries.label: Eligible warp not selected
entries.plain: The warp was ready, but another eligible warp was scheduled in that cycle.
entries.doesNotProve: A high value often means there are enough warps to hide latency and is not inherently a problem.
checks: Do not optimize this counter in isolation.

entries.label: Warp issued
entries.plain: The warp was selected and issued an instruction.
entries.doesNotProve: It is a scheduler state, not a stall cause to eliminate.
checks: Use it as context for the distribution of scheduler states.

entries.label: Short-latency dependency
entries.plain: Warps wait for MIO/shared-memory or special-function dependencies rather than L1TEX data.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify shared-memory bank conflicts or special math by itself.
checks: Inspect shared-memory and special-function instruction evidence.

entries.label: Sleeping or blocked warp
entries.plain: All threads in the warp are blocked, yielded, or sleeping.
entries.doesNotProve: It is uncommon in ordinary graphics shaders and may be irrelevant when the sample count is tiny.
checks: Check whether the metric is material to total pass time.

entries.label: Texture queue pressure
entries.plain: The L1TEX instruction queue for texture operations is full.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify a particular texture or prove DRAM bandwidth saturation.
checks: Compare texture work, cache behavior, and a reduced-fetch shader variant.

entries.label: Fixed-latency dependency
entries.plain: Warps wait on a fixed-latency execution dependency.
entries.doesNotProve: It does not identify the source instruction.
checks: Inspect instruction dependencies and whether more independent work can hide latency.

entries.label: Registers per thread
entries.plain: Average register allocation pressure for the indicated shader class.
entries.doesNotProve: Register count alone does not prove low achieved occupancy or spilling.
checks: Pair with occupancy evidence and local-memory traffic.
